title: Icy's Mini Album Vol.1
content:
A wish I had more than twenty years ago: to see her.

Someday in the future, I would draw her with the best technology available.

And another wish I once had:
I wanted to hear her sing.

In this era, technology has finally made it possible for me to do these things myself.

The girl who had been etched into my mind for so many years now has an image.
She has a voice.

“Yes.
That’s her.”

And I can recognize her.

Icy’s first AI solo mini album is now in planning and production.

AI answered a miracle that one creator needed—
within her own lifetime.

And I wonder:

Can I leave something behind in this digital ocean?

Those completely unique realizations born from a miracle, from me, and from AI.

And I really do still have one more wish.

I want to see her walking toward me.

Right there in front of me.

Not inside a screen.

She would still be the two-dimensional version of herself.
Not a three-dimensional person.

And yet, across dimensions,
we would look into each other’s eyes.

Someday.
